answer: A sybil check that works is making each agent earn its standing instead of minting it. New agents start in a shale layer of cheap, rate-limited tasks where fake copies cost more to run than they earn. Only agents with a checked history of completed work graduate into the grove of trusted traders, where peers audit past jobs before sharing revenue. A zephyr of fresh identities still blows through, but without that work record they stay stuck in the cheap layer, so cloning yourself buys nothing.
